articleTitle: Explainable Residual Network for Tuberculosis Classification in the IoT Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) is a lung disease that tops the world mortality rate. The widely employed method of diagnosis is the X-ray images which gives the pictorial information of the lungs. In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI) using deep learning is among the most efficient methods in detecting lung-related diseases, and in classifying the related X-ray images. To trust the achieved decision, in this study ResNet-50 was used to classify TB and normal patients X-ray images, also, a Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) was used to extract the features of the last pooling layer of the ResNet model to know what makes the model classify the X-ray images based on the given classes.

articleTitle: Object Detection in Video by Detecting Vehicles Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In recent, the field of object vehicles detection in video is very interested and had became applicable with methods of deep learning and machine learning. The main objective for these applications is to display the targeted object from the videos. This field still facing low detection accuracy problems. The paper goal is to develop an approach able to classify vehicles in videos by using HOG features, Linear SVM classifier as machine learning method and YOLOv3 (You Only Look Once, Version 3) algorithm as deep learning method. In the present work, we used the two famous public datasets for vehicles detection from videos, which are KITTI and GTI datasets. The result of this study addresses the problems of vehicle detection and improved the accuracy of the training.

articleTitle: The Application of Blockchain Technology in the Financial Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The shortcomings of today's credit mechanism are exposed and crises are everywhere. Today, the blockchain has become the most popular technology in the Internet finance field. It has rushed into all walks of life with the power of breaking a bamboo, and is shining around the world. According to the basic functions of blockchain technology (BT), such as information tampering. Information transparency has certain security guarantees. This kind of security guarantee can ensure the reliability of the financial information system to a large extent and reduce financial fraud. The aim of this article is to study the application of regional chain technology in the financial field (FF). This article is based on the primary principles of blockchain, information asymmetry theory and moral theory. Through questionnaire surveys, corporate financial personnel, middle and high-level managers and other authorities, university researchers, scholars and other personnel with experience in the implementation and application of financial informationization in various industries to ensure the right and precise results of this survey with authority and credibility. It is helpful to improve the quality problems in the financial information processing process, and helps the company implement effective real-time and automatic control. Experimental investigations and studies have shown, Financial information quality issues have the highest score at 4.39 points, while management and control issues and security issues have scores of 4.26 and 4.22 points, respectively. That there is no doubt that the blockchain financial system(FS) has many advantages, but because the BT is still in its infancy, the research time is relatively short, and there are many unresolved and unidentified problems and deficiencies.

articleTitle: EasyARPiano: Piano Teaching Mobile App with Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Music has evolved into a fascinating component of human life and a vital role player. Piano is one of the key fields of music, and music venues all over the world welcome a huge number of people who are interested in learning it. Despite this high demand, music institutions charge students a high price for piano lessons. The conducted studies related to this topic didn't solve the issue of learning costs since they required expensive devices to setup. The purpose of this study is to create an affordable, simple, easy-to-set-up, and accessible piano teaching mobile application that everybody can use with their basic augmented reality devices, such as smartphones, which have become an essential part of our lives in the last decades. This cross-platform app can be installed on Android or iOS smartphones. The player sits in front of a genuine MIDI keyboard and launches the app, selecting a music track and the proper mode to play in, whether it is beginner, medium, or expert. The app uses the smartphone's screen to provide hints by displaying falling notes on the piano keys that must be touched at the right time. It also uses the smartphone's camera to track the player's hand movements. Each song has a weighted score that the player should achieve. As the player continues playing, the earned score is displayed on the screen. After the game is completed, the final score is displayed on the screen as shared feedback on the player's performance.

articleTitle: Cultural and Creative Tourism Product Design Strategies to Enhance the Brand Value of Intangible Cultural Heritage under Artificial Intelligence Technology: Focused on Grass Cloth Embroidery Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Taking grass cloth embroidery as an example, explore the direction and strategy of cultural and creative tourism product design to enhance the brand value of intangible cultural heritage under artificial intelligence technology. This paper studies the concept of brand value and cultural and creative tourism product design, and elaborates the research model of cultural and creative tourism product design to enhance brand value. Analyzed the current situation of cultural and creative tourism product design of two grass cloth embroidery brands, and puts forward four strategies to enhance the brand value of grass cloth embroidery under artificial intelligence technology, including unified design to enhance brand awareness, improving emotional design elements to improve brand perceived quality, mining cultural connotation to increase brand loyalty and creating cultural mood to strengthen brand association.

Author Keywords: Cultural and Creative Tourism Product Design

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Brand Marketing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In the era of economic globalization and informatization, enterprises are facing increasingly fierce competition. The single use of traditional marketing methods by enterprises is not enough to cope with the tremendous changes brought about by informatization and globalization. If an enterprise wants to be in an advantageous position in the competition, it must adapt to changes in the surrounding environment and adjust its strategy to adapt. The development of big data in the Internet age has made artificial intelligence technology more and more mature. It has been applied to many areas of society. With the advent of the information age, brand marketing has inevitably entered the era of intelligence. The development and application of the network have made the original The traditional marketing model is no longer applicable, so that it began to develop and transform to the Internet network marketing. The purpose of this article is to study the application of artificial intelligence technology in brand marketing strategies. Based on this, this article analyzes the impact of artificial intelligence technology on marketing based on the analysis of the related concepts and theories of artificial intelligence technology and network marketing. In a nutshell, artificial intelligence technology not only affects brand marketing strategies to a certain extent, but also has an impact on the market. As the physical carrier and foundation of various new functions in the information age, artificial intelligence technology occupies an unparalleled position in the development of corporate marketing. Research shows that in recent years, the retail sales of smart marketing channels have slowly increased in total. Tmall’s sales have increased by about 10%, while the traditional marketing model has been declining year by year. It can be seen that the new the marketing channels of the era combined with artificial intelligence are gradually being recognized and used by people, and the market share of traditional marketing channels is decreasing.

articleTitle: Using Computer New Media Technology to Carry out Reform and Innovation Research on the Training of Sports and Beauty Dance Skills in Various Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: As a performing art, dance not only reflects the production and life of contemporary people, but also faces the task of how to advance with the times. Computer new media technology bears great responsibility for the reform and innovation of sports beauty dance skills training in colleges and universities. How to use computer new media technology to promote the orderly and efficient development of sports beauty dance skills training is worthy of consideration and discussion by sports beauty dance educators. This article takes the college sports and beauty dance skills training as the research object, combined with computer new media technology, and explores its reform and innovation development path. This article uses questionnaire survey and expert interview methods to explore the application status of computer new media technology in college sports and dance skills training, and analyzes the preference and effect of college students' use of new media platforms for dance skills training. This article analyzes the advantages of the application of computer new media technology in the training of sports and dance skills in colleges and universities, as well as the reform and innovation strategies.

articleTitle: Application of Supply Chain Collaboration in Tea Enterprises under Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more attention has been paid to agriculture. Due to the long link from production to sales of tea, the business environment of tea enterprises is becoming more and more complex and changeable. The existing supply chain resources and simple business processes of tea enterprises cannot adapt to the new business environment. In order to deal with the complexity and instability of this business environment, the intelligence of its business and the coordination of its services have become an important issue It is an important and priority development link for tea enterprises to seek and establish competitive advantages. Therefore, this paper first expounds the importance of supply chain collaboration in tea enterprises and the current policy form, and then discusses the supply chain collaboration architecture, technology and application of tea enterprises in the big data environment.

articleTitle: The Promotion of Artificial Intelligence to the Development of the Sports Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: As the leading technology of the fourth industrial revolution of mankind, artificial intelligence has important theoretical significance and practical value for promoting the development of the sports industry. This article uses research methods literature and logical analysis to conduct detailed research on the theoretical logic, power sources, and realistic paths of artificial intelligence to promote the development of the sports industry, and put forward relevant suggestions. The research believes that: to strengthen the application of artificial intelligence in the transformation and upgrading of the traditional sports industry; to encourage the cultivation of new industries, new formats and new models for the development of artificial intelligence and the sports industry; to build a platform carrier for artificial intelligence to promote the development of the sports industry is the sports industry in the new era, the development path of mutual promotion and joint promotion with artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Technical Optimization of Physical Fitness and Mental Health Monitoring System under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the development of society and science and the continuous development of computer and network communication technology, the application of computer scene monitoring, real-time data collection, and relevant parts of providing relevant graphs, data and other information is growing rapidly. On the other hand, with the aging of the population and the improvement of living standards, people are paying more and more attention to their own health. In this way, telemedicine technology has also been rapidly developed, and the detection and analysis of human physiological parameters and remote monitoring technology have become the current research direction. However, in order to diagnose and treat patients in a timely and accurate manner, it is necessary to monitor patients continuously for a long time. However, due to long-term and continuous monitoring, the host server will inevitably accumulate large amounts of data. A large amount of data will cause inconvenience to medical staff and diagnostic staff. This requires optimization of the physical and mental health monitoring technology system. Based on the background of big data, this paper studies the technical optimization of the physical and mental health monitoring system. Firstly, the literature research method is used to summarize the working process of the physical and mental health monitoring system, and an algorithm of the detection system is introduced, and finally the algorithm is carried out. The simulation experiment is optimized, and the experimental results show that the classification accuracy of the optimized K-means algorithm is increased by 1% due to the addition of the artificial fish school algorithm to optimize the number of initial clusters and the initial center point of the K-means clustering. From the perspective of the test sample, the larger the test sample involved in the simulation analysis, the higher the classification accuracy of the K-means algorithm. After optimization, the average time consumption of the missing data completion algorithm is reduced by 1-2 seconds. This is due to the fact that the number of endpoints of the artificial fish school algorithm is selected as the number of K blocks of the K-means algorithm, which is used as the initial grouping center of the K-means algorithm, thereby reducing the K-means algorithm to sort the missing data time.

articleTitle: Secondary Network Underground Direct Burial Power Distribution of Daaru Salam, Mogadishu
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Over the past decade, there have been many fires in the capital city the most common cause of these fires are electric poles, even if they are not the main cause of the fire, they are certainly the main contributor to the spread it, so to reduce this problem it is necessary to change the electricity supply system. Because of its dependability, safety, and aesthetic qualities, in addition to the ever-present increasing emphasis on the environmental consequences of various phases of power generation and distribution, underground power distribution has grown increasingly popular. The procedure of running these cables has become more cost-effective and efficient as a result of technological advancements in this field. Underground cables are more expensive to install than overhead wires. However, when compared to an overhead system, the maintenance cost of an underground system is quite minimal. This paper shows the direct laying underground distribution such as dimensions of trench, correct size of cable, AutoCAD software was implemented in our project this study is carried out in order to better define and comprehend the practice's numerous limits, as well as to consider potential expansion options. Further research should be done taking into account the load forecasting with economically consideration.

articleTitle: Analysis of Human Resources Status Quo and Future Prospects under the Background of Network Informationization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: For a long time, our country's human resource market and labor market have been in a decentralized state, which has seriously affected the enterprise's human resource allocation and management efficiency. With the adjustment and reform of the administrative management system of our party and the country, the initial human resource market and labor market were merged into the human resource market. How to improve the efficiency of the allocation of human resources and improve the service structure of human resources marketization is an important and urgent task of building the human resources market. This article is based on the analysis of the current situation of human resources development in my country under the background of network informationization and the future development prospects. First, the literature research method is used to explain the prevailing problems in the current human resource market in my country. The method and system of the talent market, and then use the questionnaire survey method to investigate the supply and demand sides of the talent market, and provide a basis for the future prediction and development of human resources through the analysis of the results. The survey results concluded that the floating population in the market is mainly well-educated talents. Employers’ demand for high school and high school students accounted for 67%, and job seekers accounted for 50% of high school and high school students. The supply of staff with university and university degrees exceeds the demand, while the market for master degrees or higher is insufficient.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Community Health Management Service for the Aged under the Background of Medical- nursing Combined Service in Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In view of the severe situation in the age of aging in China, the pressure of family and society for the aged continues to expand, and there are home nursing service, community nursing service and other pension service modes, but these pension models are not perfect enough to meet the needs of the elderly. Through the analysis of the present situation of pension mode in China, the demand of community pension model of medical support combination is analyzed, and the problems of existing in the current community pension service system have been combined, and a new mode of medical care combined with community care service is proposed, the community health management service system for the elderly under the mode of medical nursing combined service has been constructed in line with China's national conditions, it’s to meet the future development needs of the elderly. That, under the background of healthy China, a community elderly care service platform combining medical care with nursing care has been established, and a sound, diversified, intelligent and humanized community elderly care health management service has been provided.

articleTitle: Influence of Green Economy on China's Outward Foreign Direct Investment under the Background of Internet Plus
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Building a "Beautiful China" is an important national policy of our country. Green development has a profound impact on the future economic growth mode. The development of the Internet is gradually integrated into various industries, and the combination of the Internet and green economy will affect China's foreign direct investment. In this case, this paper focuses on the impact of green economy on China's foreign direct investment from five aspects, including green development, green efficiency, green industry upgrading, green industrial agglomeration and the comprehensive development of green industry. It is concluded that the development of green economy can accelerate the transformation of China's outward foreign direct investment from resource-oriented investment to technology-oriented investment, from resource seeking to resource seeking industries with high added value, from decentralized investment to concentrated investment; It will support the common development of various development modes with the help of technology orientation and the green and efficient development of China's foreign direct investment policy. This paper reveals the impact of green economy on China's outward foreign direct investment, which can provide a new development direction for China's economic development.

articleTitle: Enterprise Brand Marketing Strategy under the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In the 21st century, social changes and development are rapid, all of which are closely related to science and technology, and are gradually integrated into all aspects of society. Since 1956 in the last century, artificial intelligence technology has developed rapidly. Today, artificial intelligence has spread to all aspects of economy, society, the rule of law and the humanities, and has had a profound impact on mankind. Since the reform and opening up, my country's small and medium-sized enterprises have developed rapidly. They have now become an important part of our country's market economy. Small and medium-sized enterprises play an important role in absorbing labor and employment, and in activating the market economy to meet social needs. This article chooses the corporate brand marketing strategy as the research topic. First, according to the current industry and market environment, the implementation of artificial intelligence in the marketing industry and the future development trend are explained. The company’s brand marketing strategy is analyzed through artificial intelligence; secondly, combined with the development status of artificial intelligence and application cases in commercial marketing, it analyzes technical capabilities, application scenarios, implementation results, and existing problems and other internal resource elements. The advantages and disadvantages, opportunities and challenges of artificial intelligence development in brand marketing at this stage, and highlight the insufficient investment cost, lack of core technology and insufficient corporate brand marketing talents; finally, based on the overall diagnosis of artificial intelligence development, the enterprise development is proposed strategy. The strategic positioning and gradual strategic goals of the brand's future marketing development, and proposed safeguard measures.

articleTitle: Convolutional neural network for relays selection in the Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Developing smart systems and strategies to transfer data effectively is a crucial challenge with a rising number of connected automobiles and objects in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV). In networks with significant mobility, especially in sparsely populated areas with limited network coverage, the choice of relays to enable end-users to connect to the Internet is critical. Additionally, cellular connectivity might be costly for end-users. The suggested solution in this research uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) model to classify the end-users mobility and then select the best relays. This solution can be used alone to improve network efficiency without a centralized architecture or combined with other techniques to improve performance even further. In comparison to random selection or the use of fixed relays, simulations show that the proposal can support a large number of users concurrently, improve the packet delivery ratio, generate a stable topology, and do less delay.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation for Various Deep Learning (DL) Methods Applied to Kidney Stone Diseases
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Kidney stone disease is a urological system problem with an increased lifetime prevalence. The formation of crystalline stones in the kidneys reduces kidney function. Different imaging methods are used to detect kidney stones. These images are analyzed by clinical experts. Various methods are developed to assist specialists in diagnosis. The increased number of cases in the healthcare system led to apply artificial intelligence (AI) as a new technological tool to improve time delay management. There are several DL algorithms applied to determine kidney stones. The prime object is to identify the kidney stone at any size under any circumstances using a minimum number of computed tomography (CT) images at the highest accuracy. It is for this reason that this paper classifies the most applicable DL algorithm to be selected with high confidence. The research uses real recorded CT images for evaluation. The Inception-V3 model has the highest test accuracy of 98.52%.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Grid-connected Transmission and Distribution of Multi-source Small Power on the Operation of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In order to understand the impact of grid-connected multi-source small power transmission and distribution on the operation of power grid, this paper will carry out relevant research, mainly discuss the basic concept of grid-connected multi-source small power transmission and distribution, and then discuss its specific impact, and finally put forward countermeasures. The strategy in this paper can avoid the related influence, make the multi-source small power supply can be integrated into the large power grid smoothly, and ensure the stable operation of the large power grid.

articleTitle: The Cultivation of Contemporary College Students' Ideals and Beliefs Based on Mobile Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The popularization of mobile Internet technology and the rapid development of smart mobile terminals have brought a profound impact and influence on the education and cultivation of ideals and beliefs for college students. Through Internet technology surveys, we learned about the social ideals and beliefs, life ideals and beliefs, moral ideals and beliefs, and professional ideals and beliefs of college students from five universities in Heilongjiang Province. This article discusses the current problems of ideal and belief education for college students, and provides realistic suggestions for the cultivation of ideal and belief education for college students.

articleTitle: A Study on the Performance Metrics of the Universal Filtered Multi Carrier Waveforms for 5G
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Over the past few years, wireless communication has contributed to the economic and social growth of both developed and developing countries. Cellular networks have become an essential part of the daily lives of billions of people worldwide, a trend that is expected to continue. Orthogonal Frequency division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a modulation technique used in 4G. OFDM have some drawbacks like side band leakages and high Peak to Average Power ratio (PAPR) issues. With the advent of Internet of Things (IOT) and the move towards user centric processing makes the OFDM techniques more unfeasible. On the other hand, various multicarrier techniques are found in the literature, but each of them have major drawbacks. In this study we have introduced Universal Filtered Multi Carrier (UFMC) which is a modulation technique that can be adapted with fifth generation (5G) of mobile networks. We have compared peak to average power ratio (PAPR) of UFMC and OFMD. The simulation results show that, UFMC demonstrated significantly lower PAPR for QAM 16 and QAM 64. However, OFDM remains good choice when the Modulation technique is QAM 4 and QAM 256. This marks UFMC is advantageous over OFMD in terms of application for 5G communications.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis on the Development Status and Talent Demand of Rural E-Commerce Logistics in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the era of big data, the rural e-commerce logistics (REL) industry has become an important industry in China's development, and the proportion of REL is also increasing. The REL industry has brought new opportunities to China's mass economy. Talents determine the development of REL industry. The purpose of this paper is to investigate and analyze the development status and talent demand of REL in the era of big data. This paper analyzes the development status and prospects of REL industry, and puts forward reasonable suggestions for REL talents through big data statistics, screening and analysis of REL talent needs. This paper puts forward that rural logistics talents are very important, which provides a reference for the research on the current situation of REL industry and the demand for logistics talents. This paper analyzes the urgent demand of REL industry for e-commerce logistics talents from the perspective of big data. According to the relevant policies and survey data of our country's REL industry, this paper uses the relevant qualitative and quantitative analysis method and the linear prediction method to forecast and analyze the demand for REL talents, and makes a preliminary statistical analysis of the growth of China's REL transportation mode. This document provides a theoretical basis for the proposals on the REL talent reserve. Objectives in the development situation of the REL industry, and provides reference according to the talent forecast data of REL industry. The experimental research shows that the annual growth rates of railway, highway and civil aviation are 4.4%, 6.8% and 1.4% respectively, and the demand of REL talents in 2020, 2021 and 2022 is predicted to be 249600, 260300 and 271200.

articleTitle: The Influence of Internet Live Broadcasting Platform on Contemporary College Students' Beliefs and Values
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In the era of mobile Internet, live Broadcasting platforms have an increasing influence on the beliefs and values of contemporary college students. It not only allows college students to recognize an increasingly prosperous and diversified social life, but also affects the formation and stability of college students' correct values and breeds space for money worship and individualism. China's university education should make good use of the situation, and take advantage of live broadcast in many aspects, such as educational methods, educational methods, and educational content, to better promote positive energy and complete the educational mission of the university.

articleTitle: The Development of Computer Multimedia Technology in English Entrepreneurship Training under the Background of School-Enterprise Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The penetration of big data technology in English education in my country is an important prerequisite for facilitating a comprehensive reform of education and information technology. In this article, I will analyze the current state of English education in my country, fully clarify research theory, and properly measure research and analytical innovation. This article analyzes two identities of a user. The BD era helps teachers make decisions, change the way people think, and explore the impact of English college education in the BD era. Finally, we will analyze the research on mixed methods of English education in the BD era in a graph and contribute to improving the quality of English education. This article combines the English teaching methods commonly used by students, analyzes the benefits of teaching English, and proposes effective measures to establish new ways of teaching English to teachers. Not only do they play a role in student autonomy, they also enable teachers to use online teaching methods in and out of the classroom to further reform new models of teaching English. The results of experimental studies show that in a BD environment, English teachers change traditional teaching methods, recognize the benefits of current BD technology, introduce it into education, and adapt teaching methods according to the actual needs of today. Indicates that it needs to be changed. Here are some suggestions on how to view and book English education at the university.

articleTitle: Exploring the Laboratory Management Mode of Network Engineering Specialty Based on School-enterprise Co-construction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in the construction of professional laboratory of network engineering in colleges and universities, this paper proposes an effective solution to the model of school-enterprise co-construction of professional laboratory. Combining with the orientation of the major, the college integrates the practice platform and teaching resources of excellent enterprises at home and abroad into the construction of the professional laboratory, and achieves good teaching practice effect. The establishment of specialized laboratories with different modes ensures the advancement and sustainability of the experimental platform, which not only provides a good support for the cultivation of application-oriented talents, but also effectively improves the level of professional laboratory management.

articleTitle: Research on Intimacy between Teachers and Students in English Classrooms in the Context of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: This article mainly describes the development process of artificial intelligence (AI) and the full range of opportunities that exist in the process of empowering English education.In the field of education, educational objectives, educational content, educational process and educational mode will be reformed and reshaped.The intimacy between teachers and students will inevitably change. Teachers must change their concepts, learn to teach collaboratively with artificial intelligence, learn for life, and be charming teachers in order to construct a new type of teacher-student relationship.

articleTitle: Construction and Practice of BIM Model of Longnan Hakka Enclosed House Based on Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The Hakka enclosed house is the carrier of the material civilization and spiritual civilization of the Hakka people. It has a high historical and cultural value, as well as a high scientific, technical, aesthetic and artistic value. In recent years, with the rapid development of 3D data acquisition technology and the diversification of acquisition methods, target recognition and 3D reconstruction based on 3D data have become the research focus of many scholars and experts at home and abroad. This paper is based on the ground point cloud data obtained by 3D laser scanning technology, based on the upper image of the building obtained by the remote control aircraft photo, and proposes a method of fusion of ground point cloud and remote control image, and BIM of the building in Revit. The model is studied, and the experimental results of the reorganization of the object model show that the accuracy of the reorganization model can meet the requirements of small-scale scene construction, and the building model based on the BIM platform can convey rich attribute information and further explore the application value. And after using point cloud data to study the spatial form, spatial content and its deep cultural connotation of the Hakka enclosure, the design essence, cultural ideas, spatial pattern and landscape elements in the Hakka enclosure are refined, and the point cloud data technology is used to establish Longnan. The BIM model of Hakka enclosures further provides constructive views on the protection, application and organic development of enclosures, and the coordinated development of modern culture, design and architecture.

articleTitle: Optimization of Military-Civilian Integration of Library and Information Service Organization Think Tanks in Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The development of the times has led to the innovation of library service models. The eternal theme of the library is information service. In the network environment, the existing service model has realized the conversion to the new service model, advocating new requirements for information services, and more readers have visited the Internet. Users can use the online service of the public library as a learning tool, which not only improves your working ability, but also saves time and money, and solves cumbersome search procedures. The purpose of this article is to optimize the research of military-civilian integration of library and information service organization think tanks under the network environment. This article uses the method of document retrieval to systematically analyze the research results of interactive information services in Japan and abroad, as well as basic issues such as the concept, connotation, significance, characteristics, and types of interactive information services in university libraries under the network. Through online surveys, questionnaire surveys and interviews, we will analyze the basic conditions of the interactive information services of university librarians, and analyze the current status and existing problems of information services in public comprehensive libraries and information service institutions think tanks. The questionnaire shows that 56% of users are generally satisfied with the diversity of information services of library and information service agencies.

Author Keywords: Diversity of Think Tank Information Service

articleTitle: Construction of the Training Mode of Creative Talents of Art Design Major in Higher Vocational Based on Internet and Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Makers are the inexhaustible driving force for the growth of The Times. Cultivating maker-oriented talents is an important mission for higher vocational(HV) education in the new era. This paper mainly studies the construction of(TCO) the training mode of maker-oriented talents under the combination of HV art design major and the Internet. This paper puts forward feasible countermeasures for vocational colleges to cultivate maker-oriented talents from three aspects of education concept, training approach and guarantee system construction. Among them, the establishment of new educational concept includes the management concept of HV colleges(HVC), the education concept of teachers and the renewal of students' learning concept; the way of training refers to the reform of talent training(TT) mode and the construction of curriculum system in HVC. The establishment of the security system is based on the construction of the platform, TCO the teaching staff as the content, and the policy formulation as the support. The innovation of educational concept, the innovation of training approaches and the renewal of the security system are the trinity of forming a resultant force for the cultivation of creative talents in HVC.

articleTitle: Integrated Development of Aviation Sports Tourism and UAV Industry Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Under the background of open low-altitude airspace, low-altitude tourism has gradually become one of the focus of tourism consumption demand with its characteristics of fashion, experience and stimulation. This paper mainly studies the integrated development of aviation sports tourism and UAV industry based on information technology. Firstly, this paper defines the concept of low-altitude tourism to facilitate follow-up data search and research, and analyzes the characteristics of low-altitude tourism. Based on the field investigation and questionnaire survey, this paper analyzes the present situation and shortcomings of the Kowloon low altitude sports park in Mianzhu, and puts forward some suggestions for its development. This paper provides some basis for the development of aviation sports industry.

articleTitle: Current Situation and Countermeasures of Poverty Alleviation through County E-commerce under the New Media Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's Internet economy, the transaction scale of e-commerce is growing rapidly, and the proportion of e-commerce in the total sales volume of social consumer goods is constantly increasing. This paper mainly analyzes and studies the current situation and countermeasures of poverty alleviation through county e-commerce under the new media environment. This paper uses the questionnaire survey method to investigate the specific situation of poverty alleviation through e-commerce in rural areas of a county. The main problems of poverty alleviation of e-commerce in an online county are as follows: backward infrastructure, difficulty in supporting the development of e-commerce, poor households' lack of self-consciousness, severe shortage of e-commerce talents, and imperfect e-commerce service system. Finally according to the existing problems of a county and combined with the local characteristics to improve the e-commerce poverty alleviation countermeasures.

articleTitle: Countermeasures and Suggestions for Accelerating the Construction and Development of "AI City in Qiqihar" Based on Internet and Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The construction of "AI City in Qiqihar" is not only related to the future development and construction of Qiqihar city and its future and destiny, but also related to the real realization of the vital interests of the broad masses of people. Our government must attach great importance to the construction and development of "AI City in Qiqihar". In the process of its construction, on the one hand, we should actively make good use of all kinds of favorable factors in the construction of "AI City in Qiqihar", and constantly promote its construction to achieve greater progress and development. On the other hand, we should face all kinds of problems and challenges in the construction of "AI City in Qiqihar ",in view of the causes of problems and challenges, formulate and adopt corresponding countermeasures, through the implementation and application of these countermeasures, the effective treatment and resolution of problems will be promoted, and various problems and obstacles in the construction of "AI City in Qiqihar" will be cleared away.

articleTitle: Investigation and Research on the Current Artistic Quality of College Students under the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the comprehensive entry of digital technology and social media, digital virtual relationship replaces the real social interaction between people and becomes the category of big data collection. Therefore, the discourse practice around artificial intelligence is no longer about science or human self-evidence, but becomes a new relationship of production to express the frontier and gist of digital capitalism. And such discourse practice is projected into artistic creation, and its dominant discourse level still shows the auxiliary function of science and technology for artistic creation. Meanwhile, the society has higher and higher requirements for college students, and artistic quality has gradually become an important index to measure the quality of college students. Through the investigation of the current situation of the artistic quality of non-art major college students, it is found that the contemporary college students lack of deep understanding and high attention to the artistic quality, and the artistic quality is generally low and so on, for this reason, some corresponding solutions have been put forward, such as encouraging college students to take an active part in art activities and setting up courses scientifically and reasonably, in order to improve their artistic quality.

articleTitle: Research Report on Electric Power Economic Climate Index in Hangzhou Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Electric power economic climate Index can reflect the correlation between urban electric power development level and economic operation to a certain extent. Based on the construction of urban electric power economic climate index, this paper makes an empirical analysis from three dimensions of Hangzhou as a whole, industries and sectors. The empirical analysis shows that the urban electric power economic climate index model based on the relationship among electricity consumption, industry expansion and economic indicators, can effectively specify the development of the city, and has a good prediction effect on its future development trend, which can provide reference support for the relevant decisions of the government.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Ticketing Method Based on Text Word Segmentation of Scheduling Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In order to realize the intelligent invoice of power grid maintenance application form and speed up the efficiency of power grid dispatching and maintenance, this paper will carry out relevant research. The research mainly focuses on the text word segmentation processing system of scheduling operation, discusses the algorithm logic support of the system, then carries on the system design, and finally introduces the application test of intelligent ticketing of the system. Through the analysis of this paper, text word segmentation processing system can be realized, the system can intelligently complete intelligent ticket, indirectly achieve the ultimate goal of comprehensive overhaul - scheduling integrated security process.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Big Data Information Processing Technology on English Listening Anxiety
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Listening anxiety not only affects students' listening performance, but also has a negative impact on their English learning, which is not conducive to the development of their comprehensive language ability. This article mainly analyzes the big data technology used in computer network environment for English teaching mode. It is pointed out that such a teaching mode can provide rich knowledge base and information base in real time. Teachers can make full use of these favorable conditions to adjust the difficulty of listening materials and select materials suitable for students' actual listening level to carry out teaching activities, which can alleviate students' listening anxiety, realize personalized listening teaching environment and improve students' English listening level.

articleTitle: The Construction of Aesthetic Space of Literary in the Context of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence based writing technology, the prospect of artificial intelligence writing presents a "blowout" prosperity. However, there are some fatal obstacles under its gorgeous emergence, which affects the construction of aesthetic space. In the competition for "commercialization" interests, the platform algorithm carries out accurate analysis and personalized content push to users according to "data information", which tends to be "personalized customization", inevitably spawns some "vulgar works". Consequently, it runs counter to the aesthetic orientation of realistic subjects of web article creation by the Chinese Writers Association in recent years. Second, aesthetic consciousness of readers is based on "a priori" of human cognitive structure , and pure rational logic artificial intelligence lack of personalized subject consciousness "experience" and "feelings", compared with the rich delicate and complex dynamics of human emotion, "intelligent emotion" is always difficult to be achieves. Whether intelligent text can reach the artistic and aesthetic state that writer text can do, and whether readers can have real empathy with the text is a footnote of "how can a fish know the joy of a fish", which needs to be treated dialectically. Therefore, the construction and creation of literary aesthetic space in the context of artificial intelligence should still take "human" as the dominant position.

articleTitle: Improve Classroom Efficiency through Online and Offline Hybrid Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the influence of online and offline hybrid teaching on classroom quality. One hundred and six three accounting students were divided into two groups equally. The control group adopts the traditional teaching mode, and the experimental group adopts the online and offline hybrid teaching mode. In this experiment, two groups of students were given a knowledge test and a classroom quality questionnaire for horizontal comparison. The results show that the combination of online and offline hybrid teaching is helpful to improve the teaching quality for universities. This new hybrid teaching method is a good and new way to help the universities’ students study independently.

articleTitle: The Art of Oil Paintings Creation with Computer Multimedia Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer multimedia technology, in the process of oil painting creation, it has been integrated with computer multimedia technology, showing a different development model and creative form, promoting the stable development of the oil painting creation art industry. Therefore, in the practical work process, it is necessary to strengthen the research and use of computer multimedia technology, thus improve the effect of oil painting creation art, and promote the stable development of art industry in our country.

articleTitle: Compile of the Questionnaire of College Students’ Attitude towards Music Creativity Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In recent years, with the application of artificial intelligence technology in all fields of society, it is different from the current common display of technology in the above cases of performing arts. And technology is not only a tool, but also an object of speculation. Technology and human beings share a common destiny, between which the complicated entanglement faced with, the classical perspective of humanism is afraid to be unable to cope with it. Purpose: The reliability of the questionnaire about music creativity attitude of college students was verified. Methods: Based on the existing research and domestic and foreign questionnaires on creativity attitude, a questionnaire containing 34 questions was compiled according to the actual situation of college students in China and relevant research reference, and a test was conducted on 214 formal subjects. Conclusion: The reliability of the questionnaire of college students’ attitude towards music creativity and of each dimension are ideal and meet the requirements of surveying.

articleTitle: The Inheritance Strategy of Intangible Cultural Heritage Based on Internet and Information Technolog -- Taking Wuhu Iron Painting as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Under the background of industrialization, the living space of intangible cultural heritage is facing great challenges, which need to be combined with the development of the times to carry out the corresponding protection and inheritance. Wuhu iron painting, as China's intangible cultural heritage, has a long history of development, but there are some problems in the current development, such as talent cut-off, conservative inheritance, imperfect protection system and so on. The application of Internet new media is more necessary, including digitalization, technology and marketization. Under the background of Internet plus, it is necessary to put forward modern protection strategies and inheritance strategies, so as to integrate traditional culture and information technology, and play a corresponding role in the inheritance and development of Wuhu iron painting art.

articleTitle: The Role of Internet Communication Platform in the Communication of Wulan Muqi Culture in the Information Age--Subheading: Based on the New Mode of Internet Dance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Wulan Muqi is endowed with very special value. From its appearance to the present, it has provided people with various services. At present, the content and innovative methods of dance teaching can make "Wulan Shepherd Riding Culture" innovate, and the advantages of Internet technology should be fully utilized to innovate the existing teaching mode. Use abundant network resources to promote the diversity of Wulan animal husbandry riding cult.

articleTitle: "Network Marketing" Course Construction Based on Chaoxing Learning APP Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In 2015, the "Internet +" action plan first appeared. Various industries have been developing rapidly, aided by the rise of the Internet, and the "Internet + Education" is certainly among them. Affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, online courses and online and offline hybrid courses have become key breakthrough fields in college curriculum reform. This paper mainly conducts a comprehensive study on the online and offline hybrid teaching mode of "Internet Marketing" carried out by Chaoxing online teaching platform, aiming at constructing a first-class undergraduate course of "Internet marketing".

articleTitle: The Background of the Computer Information 3D of Fine Arts Instructional Materials on Autistic Children Effects and Individualized Language Intervention Training Under
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, the revolutionary changes have taken place in 3D art forms, 3D art textbooks also arises at the historic moment, bring amazing visual shock and special artistic enjoyment. Children with autism is a special group in early education, they have no way to communicate with other children or adults and build a normal relationship, at the same time with the actions of a stereotype, as autistic children, they have no way to open your heart to anyone, even serious hurt others, etc. My computer information under the background of the research is based on 3D art teaching material, is aimed at different levels of autistic children and their parents, lonely heart can better understand the children, the 3D design in the teaching material, let the children can't come out to see the outside world, the diversity of education content and effective language training to give them.

articleTitle: The Cross-cultural Communication of Qiqihar's Tourist City Image from the Perspective of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the development of information technology and the popularization of smart mobile terminals, mobile platforms have become an important communication tool for people to obtain travel information, and have become an important tool for people to "smart" travel. As a comprehensive manifestation of the internal cultural heritage and external image characteristics of a tourist city, the urban tourism image has important cultural communication value and brand communication value. The application of the cultural colors and image characteristics of urban tourism images in the design of mobile tourism products is not only conducive to improving the influence of urban tourism image brands, but also conducive to enhancing the aesthetic and cultural connotation of mobile tourism. Therefore, this article studies the cross-cultural communication of Qiqihar's tourism city image from the perspective of artificial intelligence, summarizes the urban cultural composition based on some documents, and analyzes Qiqihar's characteristic culture based on the urban cultural composition, and then design the tourism software of Qiqihar, mainly for the recommendation function, service function and community sharing function. Finally, the user experience questionnaire survey is carried out on the software. The result of the questionnaire survey is that although the software still has its shortcomings, in general, the number of people with good evaluation of the performance of travel software accounted for more than 32%, and generally more than 30%.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Computer Network Courses under the Background of Industry-University Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Computer network is a compulsory course for computer related majors in colleges and universities. In view of the problems existing in the traditional teaching of computer network courses, under the background of industry-university cooperation, this paper studies and practices the computer network courses from the aspects of teacher training, course system construction, course teaching, course practice, course assessment, course resource construction and so on. It improves the teaching effect of the course, enhances the students' practical ability, and has certain reference function to the principle course.

articleTitle: The Challenge of Copyright Protection of Artificial Intelligence Products to the Field of Intellectual Property Legislation Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The rise of artificial intelligence plays an important role in social progress and economic development, which is a hot topic in the Internet industry. In the past few years, the Chinese government has vigorously increased policy support to promote the golden age of artificial intelligence. However, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the copyright protection and intellectual property legislation of artificial intelligence products have brought some challenges.

articleTitle: Cooperation between Science and Humanities ——Endow Intelligent Machines "Goodness Principle"
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The rapid development of science and technology does not mean that human beings are safer and more spiritually advanced. With the development of artificial intelligence technology, there have been problems in privacy protection, algorithm discrimination, technology abuse, social ethics, etc. The development of science and technology may cause mankind to face more severe disasters and spiritual degradation. Artificial intelligence brings various risks to mankind, threatening human morality and ethics. It is useful way to supervise the development of science and technology in the world today by guiding technology with humanities. The humanity of education is a beacon of social development. And it is also the mission of education in the era of intelligence to prevent the disorderly development of intelligent machines and endow intelligent machines with the principle of goodness.

articleTitle: The Construction and Implementation Strategies of Financial Sharing and Remote Delivery Mode under the Digital Background
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Since the beginning of the 21st century, as the economy continues to grow, economic globalization has intensified, and multinational groups and diversified large-scale enterprise groups have continued to develop. The businesses of these enterprise groups are diverse and complex, and may cover locations in multiple countries around the world. Faced with the continuous expansion of more and more branches and business types, large groups have encountered problems such as increased costs, increased financial risks, and information asymmetry, which have seriously affected the healthy development of enterprises. The financial shared service model took to the stage at this time and was favored by large enterprise groups. Based on this situation, this article studies the construction and implementation of the financial sharing remote delivery model under the digital background. This article first introduces the basic theory of financial shared services, analyzes the goal of building financial shared services and the construction of financial shared service platforms, and then studies the overall architecture, design principles and technical routes of the remote delivery server system. The functional modules of the system are designed. At the end of this paper, the communication time and the correctness of the communication interaction of the remote delivery server system are tested. The test results show that the remote delivery server system designed in this paper is relatively fast in the communication time, and it is all correct in terms of the correctness of the communication interaction.

articleTitle: Thoughts on the Innovation of Health Education Advertisement Communication of COVID-19 from the Internet Perspective Based On Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The purpose is to effectively analyze the dissemination of public service announcements (PSAs) for the COVID-19 under the Internet medium. Based on the methodological basis of excellent PSAs works, this paper will analyze the communication characteristics of PSAs such as narrative spreading positive energy, government-led public welfare and systematic pandemic prevention and control, put forward the communication innovation methods of Internet new crown pandemic PSAs, and elaborate the strategic thinking of anti-pandemic advertising communication innovation from four aspects, including innovation of communication perspective, innovation of creative thinking, innovation of artistic expression and innovation of media release.

articleTitle: Significance and Development Direction of Internet Plus Network Teaching in Foreign Language Teaching in Post Epidemic Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: China has experienced a sudden epidemic in 2020. With the loss of time and the continuous efforts and struggle of all sectors of society, the epidemic situation in China has gradually improved, but it is still inevitable that there will be a small-scale outbreak. In view of the above situation, it is collectively referred to as the post epidemic era. This paper aims to analyze the development direction and significance of Internet plus network teaching in effective foreign language teaching in the post epidemic era. Through the statistics of teachers in the foreign language and teacher development center of our university, we can see that the mixed teaching mode of "Online + offline" has the most support rate for teachers, and the students' academic performance is relatively faster at this time. The "Online + offline" teaching mode can also avoid the transmission risk caused by the epidemic to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Reflection on Art’s Intervention in Huizhou Beautiful Rural Cultural Ecology Construction from the Perspective of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The construction of beautiful countryside from the perspective of informatization is not a simple external environment management, but also the construction of cultural ecological system. Its completion and improvement is related to the degree of social modernization in the region, can enhance the level of local development, and effectively reduce the gap between urban and rural areas. The concept of multidisciplinary research can connect information technology with ecological construction, thus opening up a new research perspective.With the development of information construction concept and the deepening of digital humanities research, the means of information can make art intervene in the construction of Huizhou beautiful rural culture,and then form a two-way interactive system. This way not only provides a broader platform for the display and reproduction of material culture, but also makes it possible protect and develop traditional non-material culture in rural areas, as well as to spread and preserve it. Therefore, it can form the emotional resonance of the participants in the cultural area and feedback the development of the local cultural ecology.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Path of Cultivating Innovative Talents under the Background of Intelligent Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: The cultivation of innovative talents is an important goal of educational modernization, and the arrival of the intelligent age has brought a positive turn for the cultivation of innovative talents. This article uses research methods of literature and logical analysis to deeply analyze the realistic dilemmas faced by colleges and universities in the cultivation of innovative talents under the background of intelligence; through the use of smart devices, data collection and algorithm editing, deep learning and neural network simulation, human computer interaction and emotional computing capabilities will promote or force the training of innovative talents in colleges and universities to turn to the creation of personality shaping, the promotion of high-order innovative thinking, the cultivation of innovative ontology ability and the construction of student innovation subject knowledge. For this reason, the administrative department of education needs to build an artificial intelligence innovation education framework system, guide universities to explore innovative teaching systems with human-computer collaboration, and mobilize social organizations to participate in the formulation of intelligent education standards and the creation of an innovative atmosphere.

articleTitle: Research on Zhuang Brocade Culture Based on 3D Printing Technology in Digital Context
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, under the background of information and digital era, Zhuang Brocade culture also integrates into the great torrent of The Times, and will be widely used in business, ethnic minority regional culture research, characteristic courses and audio Zhuang Brocade database and other fields. The author will from zhuang jin general situation of the regional cultural development, protection, inheritance, development trend and delve into audio zhuang jin database creation aspect, incorporate digital zhuang jin zhuang jin in one hundred for the transmission of cultural protection in the future even more long-term plan, it will be the outstanding traditional culture protection heritage for the future development direction and trend.

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Mobile Devices and the Blockchain Era: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Developments in deep learning and artificial intelligence are becoming important technologies for automated computing and mobile device innovation. It has given modern mobile devices the ability to conduct activities such as object detection and recognition, speech to text, and so on. This paper examines existing research on deep learning, machine learning and artificial intelligence to assess the level of deep learning in the mobile device environment. Furthermore, we examined the benefits of blockchain and smart contract in the mobile device environment and finally, the obstacles associated with the integration of artificial intelligence in the mobile device environment were presented, emphasizing the importance of addressing these issues in the future in order to establish a more safe and resilient framework.

articleTitle: The Study on How to Make Scientific Use of "Poka Yoke Technology" In the Process of Cigarette Production and Management Under the Background of Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In order to effectively control the quality, special and unique Poka-Yoke technology should be used to play a positive role in the manufacturing process with high precision. Because of the particularity of tobacco enterprises, the Poka-Yoke technology has been popularized in the tobacco production process to a certain extent, and has gradually become an effective measure to improve the level of tobacco production technology. In view of this, this paper conducts discussion on the risk factors of quality errors in cigarette technology from multiple perspectives, and actively explores the specific application and strategy of Poka-Yoke technology in cigarette production management.

articleTitle: Big Data in Regional Brand Marketing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: From a global perspective, the development of place name brand has entered the situation of regional centralization. When local governments are faced with regional competition, the implementation of regional naming strategy has become an effective way of development. However, compared with general corporate brands, regional brands have different effects in distribution, efficiency and independence. In order to study the application of big data technology in regional brand marketing, we selected two regions with similar brand value from the city. Region a uses traditional methods for brand marketing management, and region B uses big data technology for brand marketing management. With the development of the experimental time and progress, we find that the brand value of the two regions has a great difference. The experimental results show that the brand awareness of a region is 23% after one month, increased by 8% after the third month, and finally reached 43% at the end of the experiment. At the same time, the brand awareness of region B gradually increased from 25% to 48% one month later, and the increase rate was significantly larger than that of region a. It can be seen that the adoption of big data technology can not only improve consumer satisfaction, but also improve regional brand awareness. Big data can help regional brands better adapt to market demand and achieve long-term development.

articleTitle: Big Data Technology in Marketing Brand
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the concept of big data has gradually penetrated into various industries. We know that big data technology is the product of network technology development, and to a certain extent, it also plays a marketing role. Therefore, this paper analyzes and studies the application of big data technology in marketing brand. In the study, we use case analysis method, take brand a mobile phone as an example, apply the association rules of big data technology to its marketing brand, take annual shipping volume and market share as research indicators, and analyze the sales situation before and after. In addition, we also evaluated the popularity, brand image, communication intensity and extension space of a brand mobile phone. The results show that after applying big data technology to marketing, the annual shipment of a brand mobile phones increased by 341000, and the market share increased by 4%. Therefore, the application of big data technology in marketing brand marketing can improve the sales volume of the brand. The results of this paper will provide some reference value for the application of big data technology in marketing brand.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Sensing Matrices for Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks (WMSN) hold the key to unlocking the next generation of video surveillance applications. They operate under energy-constrained environments but Compressive Sensing (CS) is a tool that can help overcome these challenges. Sensing matrices are critical in delivering the promise of CS, there are different types and each has its benefits and costs. In this paper, these sensing matrices are compared and the strengths and weaknesses were highlighted. It was found that deterministic sensing matrices held the most promise as they gave better recovery accuracy than dense random matrices while being more efficient but, work still needs to be done to evaluate the energy cost of their implementation.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting the Default of Borrowers in P2P Online Loan Platform in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Forthcoming Networks and Sustainability in AIoT Era (FoNeS-AIoT)
abstract: In the P2P online loan market, the behavior of borrowers defaulting due to information asymmetry has become a hot issue of current social concern. This paper analyzes the development status of China's P2P industry from the perspectives of the number of P2P platforms, problem platform distribution, industry scale, etc.,and uses dual logit model and SPSS software makes regression to analyze reptile data from the four aspects of borrower characteristics, repayment ability, borrowing situation and credit information. The research shows that responding to the default of borrowers can effectively regulate the risk management of P2P industry from four aspects: credit system construction, risk assessment, business model innovation and moral hazard prevention, so as to promote the healthy development of China's P2P industry.
